See the choices in person.

It’s easier to compare colors and textures when you can see them in person. At the showroom, we can look at shutter finishes, shade fabrics and drapery samples together.

John started with installation, and that experience still shapes the advice we give. We consider how a treatment fits the window, how much of the view you’ll have when it’s open and which controls you prefer.

Meet John Crawford

Blinds, shades, shutters and drapery

We carry Hunter Douglas and Alta window treatments. Start with the look you like, then compare the fabrics, materials and controls available for your windows.

  • Shades

    Compare roller, honeycomb, Roman, woven wood and sheer shades for daylight, privacy and texture.

  • Shutters

    Compare wood, composite and vinyl shutters to find a finish and style you like.

  • Blinds

    Explore wood, faux wood and metal blinds, along with vertical options for broad windows and doors.

  • Drapery

    Explore fabrics and hardware for custom drapery, on its own or layered with a shade.

  • Motorized shades

    Learn about motorized shade options and how we handle installation and setup.

Prefer to compare samples at home?

We also offer free in-home consultations in Woodland Hills and Warner Center. Seeing samples in your room makes it easier to compare colors and see how the fabric changes the light.

We’ll bring samples, talk through your ideas and budget, and take measurements during the visit.

  1. Compare the options

    We’ll look at the light, privacy and appearance you want in each room.

    Consultation & measuring

  2. Check the fit

    We check the size and shape of the windows so we can recommend options that fit well.

    How we measure and install

  3. Help with the controls

    We can explain the control options and show you how they work, including motorization where available.

    Motorization & setup

Planning a visit or a project

Do I need an appointment for the showroom?

Yes. Our Woodland Hills showroom is open by appointment, Monday–Saturday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m. Call or use the contact form to request a showroom visit, and we’ll arrange a time with you.

Can you help with just one window?

Yes. John has always welcomed single-window projects. You can come to us for one blind, a room you’re updating or window treatments for a whole home.

What if I need a blind or shade repaired?

We review the product, its condition and the parts available to see whether a repair is possible. The repair request form lets you describe the problem and attach photos.

Send a repair request
